text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Just in time. Tran-senpai was 
just teaching me about some handy gadgets—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...? What's wrong? You seem a bit 
down...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that stopwatch? Yeah, the parts have 
definitely deteriorated~. So the repair 
shop turned you down?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stopwatch I bought as a keepsake when 
I was hired as a Trainer broke this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that said, if we have the parts, it 
might not be impossible to fix. Whatcha 
wanna do?
choice_data_list:
No, it's a shame, but I'll buy a different 
one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Today must have marked the end of its 
lifespan. It would be quicker time-wise to 
simply buy a new one.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...... Still... it really is precious to 
you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, would it be okay if I held onto it for 
just a little bit?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Easier said than done, though~... How am 
I gonna find the parts... Mmm~...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I know! At times like this—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lost items, counterfeits, no problem at 
all! Leave it all to Lady Shiraoki~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Hunnyaka~~ Honnyaka~~!! Find it~, seek 
it~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha! There's a silhouette behind the 
school building!! Checking it out will 
surely bring great fortune!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Behind the school building...! I'll go 
check it out! Thank you, Fukukitaru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think the place Fukukitaru-chan 
mentioned was around here, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *cough*... Huh? Dantsu-san! What 
are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! Just looking for something. What 
about you, Tsurumaru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. My cough is pretty bad today, so I 
thought I'd train somewhere with fewer 
people around.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling great aside from this cough, 
but I really don't want to get in 
everyone's way!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Now then, back to the 30-second training—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Hmmm? Huh, no response... Wait, 
don't tell me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, I broke it again~...! I always end 
up pressing the buttons too hard~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Hey, Tsurumaru-chan! Can I have that 
broken stopwatch!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I managed to take it apart this 
far! But what do I do now...? The screw 
head is completely stripped—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ In times like this, a handy rotary 
tool does the trick.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah! The screw came out cleanly! That's an 
amazing skill, Heart-chan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special! I'm just glad it 
went well♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
DIY is a part of everyday life in America. 
So when I heard about it, I thought I 
could lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You even accompanied me to the reptile 
cafe the other day— I really owe you, 
Dants-san. Consider this my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Tweak this part... connect it... and 
then, put it back.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—The functional check came back clear. 
Well? Didn't it turn out pretty great?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! T-Trainer-san! I'm moving just fine!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not really~. I got to tinker with a 
bunch of stuff, so I'm satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, that's it for me. Catch ya later~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we were able to fix it safely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a stopwatch I had already given up 
on. But her sheer persistence and 
communication skills managed to get this 
machine ticking once again...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
!! I know, right! Everyone's just so 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-chan always gives us all kinds 
of hints with her fortune-telling! And 
Heart-chan is super good with her hands!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tran-senpai handles gadgets like a pro... 
and Tsurumaru-chan was working so hard she 
almost broke her stopwatch...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, every single one of them is 
amazing~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you thought so too, didn't you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She does nothing but sing her friend's 
praises, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
""............ But... it is something 
precious to you, isn't it?""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, she was the very first 
one to make a move.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer, is something wrong?
choice_data_list:
You're the one I want to thank most of 
all.

You're the one I want to thank most of 
all.
Your initiative is amazing too, Dantsu
Your initiative is amazing too, Dantsu

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer, is something wrong?
choice_data_list:
You're the one I want to thank most of 
all.

You're the one I want to thank most of 
all.
Your initiative is amazing too, Dantsu
Your initiative is amazing too, Dantsu

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! ...Thank, you very much. Um... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Since I heard it was something precious, 
well, I thought I'd like to preserve its 
shape for you."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's precious to me, because it's filled 
with your feelings, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...No. This is really all I can do. Even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If I was able to help you and repay you 
even a little bit, Trainer—that makes me 
happy. Fufu.
